description.en: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) for DeepSeek Harness: pair WeChat accounts by scanning a QR code in the Plugins panel, then talk to your agent from WeChat or WeCom with one DSH conversation per contact or group. Text, images, video, documents and archives travel both ways; inbound media is decrypted to $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox and handed to the model as a path. Sensitive operations can be approved from the chat (reply 1 to allow once, 2 to reject; a timeout falls back to the GUI), and a card lists every chat with Allow / Ignore / Clear plus an optional allowlist. WeCom has three paths: a group-robot webhook, a self-built app, and a two-way intelligent robot over its long connection, which needs no public URL. State persists under $DSH_HOME, so a restart keeps the login. No external service, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的个人微信 + 企业微信桥：在插件面板扫码配对，之后在微信或企业微信里和 agent 对话，每个联系人/群各自一个独立 DSH 会话。文字、图片、视频、文档、压缩包双向互通；收到的媒体解密落盘到 $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox 并以路径交给模型，agent 可通过 wechat_send_file / wecom_send_file 把文件发回。敏感操作可在聊天里直接审批（回 1 批准一次、回 2 拒绝，超时自动转回 GUI），卡片面板列出所有联系人与群，可逐条允许/忽略/清除，并可开启「只接收白名单」。企业微信有三条链路：群机器人 webhook、自建应用、以及双向的智能机器人长连接（无需公网地址），企微会话与微信共享同一套会话、白名单、远程审批与回复中继。状态持久化在 $DSH_HOME，重启保留登录、一键重新配对。无外部服务、无运行时依赖。
